sloka: गृध्रैरनुगताश्चास्य वमन्त्यो ज्वलनं मुखैः ।प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यः संरब्धमशिवं शिवाः ।। ६.१०८.२७ ।।
transliteration: gṛdhrairanugatāścāsya vamantyo jvalanaṁ mukhaiḥ ।praṇedurmukhamīkṣantyaḥ saṁrabdhamaśivaṁ śivāḥ ।। 6.108.27 ।।

translations.english: The rays of the Sun fell in front of Ravana, in red, yellow, white, and dark like minerals on the mountain.
